antiScam.title: We never ask candidates for money to apply
antiScam.text: Applying on IconBridge is free. If someone asks you to pay in our name, do not pay and contact us.

cost.q: Does it cost anything to apply?
cost.a: No. Creating a profile and applying are free. We never ask candidates for money to apply.

documents.a: A CV and a scan of a valid passport. Diplomas and certificates help. Cruise jobs also need STCW training, a seaman's book and a medical certificate.

time.q: How long does the process take?
time.a: It depends on the employer and the country. After an offer, a work permit and a visa usually take several weeks to a few months.

status.q: How do I follow my application?
status.a: In your account. You also receive an email each time the status of your application changes.

reapply.q: Can I apply again to the same job?
reapply.a: You can apply to the same job once every 6 months. You can apply to other jobs at any time.

data.q: What happens to my personal data?
data.a: It is used only for your applications. You can download or delete your data from your account at any time.

about.title: About IconBridge
about.intro: IconBridge Recruitment Ltd connects candidates with employers in Malta, Poland and on cruise ships, and stays by their side until they arrive.
about.mission: To make working abroad safe and understandable: clear offers, honest information and a team that answers.

legal.draftNotice: This text is a general model. Have it reviewed by a legal adviser before the site opens.

who.title: Who is responsible for your data
who.text: IconBridge Recruitment Ltd operates this site and decides how the personal data collected here is used.

what.title: What we collect
what.text: Identity and contact details, passport details, professional profile, the documents you upload and your applications. Passport numbers are stored encrypted.

why.title: Why we use it
why.text: To handle your applications, present your profile to employers for the jobs you applied to, and prepare work permit and visa files. We do not sell your data.

share.title: Who receives it
share.text: Our recruiters, the employers of the jobs you apply to, and the authorities that process permits and visas. Technical providers host the site on our behalf.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.text: As long as your account exists, then for the period required by law. You can delete your account at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can access, correct, download and delete your data from your account, or by writing to us. You can also complain to your data protection authority.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: The site only uses the cookies needed to sign you in and remember your language and colour theme. No advertising tracker is used.

service.title: The service
service.text: The site lets candidates see job offers and apply. IconBridge acts as an intermediary between candidates and employers.

free.title: Free for candidates
free.text: Creating an account and applying are free. IconBridge never asks candidates for money to apply.

account.title: Your account
account.text: Give accurate information and keep your password secret. One person, one account.

applications.title: Applications
applications.text: Applying does not guarantee a job. You can apply to the same job once every 6 months. Employers make the final decision.

content.title: Your documents
content.text: Upload only documents that are yours and genuine. False documents lead to the closing of the account.

liability.title: Limits
liability.text: We do our best to keep offers accurate and the site available, without guarantee. Visa decisions belong to the authorities.

law.title: Changes and contact
law.text: These terms may change; the date above shows the latest version. Questions: use the contact page.
